entities.summary: Paul van Dyk (b. 1971-12-16, Eisenhüttenstadt) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Eisenhüttenstadt and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
